summary: Portland General Electric filed an 8-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing Oregon Public Utility Commission final Order No. 26-354 in Docket UM 2385 on its proposed holding-company reorganization (the US equivalent of a scheme of arrangement/redomiciliation). The order grants roughly $83 million in rate credits and customer benefits, which PGE supports, but adds dividend and credit-rating conditions exceeding the stipulated terms and depart from customary Oregon structures. PGE says it will not proceed unless those provisions are clarified or modified, and is weighing reconsideration, clarification, or judicial review. Watch for reconsideration timing and any revised reorganization plan.
